quest.title: Price Comparison
quest.description: Azalai from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by one of his orders.

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Made up your mind yet? Want to place your order with me?

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Rama
response.text: Thanks for your patronage! Please wait a moment while I make preparations and arrange delivery.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Rama
response.text: Alright. But hurry up, please. If you wait too long, I may be out of stock.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: I'll have to ask Raef to find someone...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why the long face?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: What are you looking to buy, Traveler? I'm afraid that we may be somewhat out of stock.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that's what troubles you?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Yes... This is a desert village, so shipment has always been troublesome for us.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Whenever I want to source some wares, I need to ask those who happen to leave the village to place an order for me, then transport it to the village together with Raef.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: One way or another, my business costs are slowly rising. To make ends meet, I have no other choice than to increase my prices.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Thankfully, the people of this village understand my predicament and are willing to support my business, otherwise... I would've gone bankrupt a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: But, alas... I can't find anyone who's planning to leave the village, and Raef and his crew aren't always available...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: If I'm unlucky, some low-volume goods may be out of stock soon...

choices.text: And those goods are...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: They are all daily essentials. Even though I'm usually quick to source them, they sell even quicker.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: I'm running a small business, so I can't always buy large volumes.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Ahem... that's a topic for another day. Traveler, perhaps you are getting ready to leave the village?

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: I've been wanting to source some spices and need someone to place an order for me... Could you assist me with this?

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Let me see... <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama's</color> spices are fairly priced and the quality is... serviceable.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Jut</color> has recently got his hands on some novelty spices — the quality's quite promising. I'd like to give them a shot, just to see if there's any demand, but I'm not sure about the price point...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: But my budget for this purchase is limited, so deciding which supplier to choose isn't going to be easy...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Traveler, please check out both suppliers and pick one to place an order with.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Oh, one more thing. Whenever I commissioned someone to place an order for me in the past, I'd ask them to look for a relatively cheap price point.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: I'd like you to do the same. Please remember to look for the cheaper supplier.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: The business strategy that's been working in Aaru Village so far is "selling more at a lower profit margin."

choices.text: I'll check out what <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama</color> has to offer first...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Thank you in advance. I'll mark her location on the map for you.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Alright, come back anytime if you have any additional questions.

choices.text: I'll check out what <color=#00E1FFFF>Jut</color> has to offer first...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Thank you in advance. I'll mark his location on the map for you.

choices.text: So spices are out of stock in your store?

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: I wouldn't say we've run out completely... but given how big the sales volumes are, it's always better to have some more in stock.

choices.text: If only you could find a long-term business partner...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: It's not like I haven't considered that, but look around you.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Shipping goods into the village and running business here aren't exactly easy.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: How did it go? Have you placed an order yet?

choices.text: About <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama's</color> location...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: You can't find her exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: You should be good to go now. I'm counting on you, Traveler.

choices.text: About <color=#00E1FFFF>Jut's</color> location...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: You can't find his exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.

response.text: Hahaha... Trust me, Traveler. Drying fish out in the desert is not a good idea...

dialogues.text: How did it go? Have you placed an order yet?

choices.text: About <color=#00E1FFFF>Butrus'</color> location...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: You can't find his exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: You should be good to go now. I'm counting on you, Traveler.

choices.text: About <color=#00E1FFFF>Jahangir's</color> location...

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: Hey, have you decided yet? One word and I'll start prepping everything.

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Jahangir
response.text: Okay! I'll send one of my employees to deliver the order when I'm done making Dried Fish.

choices.text: I—I'm going to look elsewhere...

response.speaker: Jahangir
response.text: Huh? Didn't I say you wouldn't find such tasty Dried Fish elsewhere? There's not much to think about...

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Welcome! Want to buy some spices? We have all the usuals, and all at affordable prices!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Azalai's order...

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Huh? Azalai asked you to place an order for him? No problem at all...

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: It's just that he used to ask the Eremites to source his goods, and this time, he commissioned an Adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Ahem! What's his budget today? Let's see... Ooh, quite a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Uh, if you place an order at my store, the spices supplied by me should last him for a long while.

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: As for the selling price... Just like before, I suggest setting a slightly lower price point. That's an easy way to boost sales.

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Rama
response.text: Oh! Thanks for your patronage! Please wait a moment while I make preparations and arrange delivery.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Rama
response.text: Okay... Come back and tell me if you change your mind.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Azalai up to speed on sourcing goods...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Hm... Ordered from Rama's? Should be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Her spices are both cheap and of good quality, very popular with the people of this village. Once they arrive, selling them shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. This is your remuneration. And this Mora, please take it along, too.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: That miser Rama though... I've ordered so many times from her, and she never gave me a discount.

dialogues.speaker: Butrus
dialogues.text: Welcome! Are you looking for fish? Then you've come to the right place! There are no fish fresher than mine. Ask that cat over there if you don't believe me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Azalai's order...

dialogues.speaker: Butrus
dialogues.text: Huh... Azalai is looking to source some Dried Fish from me? No worries.

dialogues.speaker: Butrus
dialogues.text: This amount of Mora is enough to buy a large quantity of Dried Fish. It should last him for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Butrus
dialogues.text: Though my Dried Fish is... well... faithful to the original flavor! No spices or anything like that.

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Butrus
response.text: Alright! Hehe... I'll go pick out some Dried Fish and get someone to deliver his order to him in a bit.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Butrus
response.text: Huh? Fine... Go ahead and compare prices.

response.speaker: Butrus
response.text: But I can't really afford to give you another discount. I won't make any profit otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Butrus
dialogues.text: What say you? Want to order Dried Fish from me?

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Butrus
response.text: Alright! Hehe... I'll go pick out some Dried Fish and get someone to deliver his order to him in a bit.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Butrus
response.text: Don't be too long or there won't be any Dried Fish left.

talks.objective: Learn about the situation from Butrus

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Hi, are you shopping for spices?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Azalai's order...

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: For this amount... He won't be able to buy much. However, my spices are worth a lot of Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Well... Since it's his order, I'll add my two cents. As a friend, I don't really recommend him to buy from me.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: From what I gathered about business in Aaru Village... I'd say that "selling more at a lower price point" is the way to go.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Simply put, it's about selling goods of passable quality for a relatively low price, and selling large quantities fast as a way to make a quick return on the invested capital.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Conversely, if he tries to sell expensive high-quality goods in Aaru Village, the return will be slow.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: But this is just my opinion. It's up to him what kind of goods he decides to sell.

choices.text: I'd like to order from you.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Alright. I'll go prepare the goods then.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: All good. If you still want to order from me, feel free to come back anytime.

talks.objective: Learn about the situation from Jahangir

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: How's it going? Made up your mind yet?

choices.text: I'd like to order from you.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: Alright. I'll go prepare the goods then.

choices.text: I'll try my luck elsewhere.

response.speaker: Jut
response.text: I understand. We're talking about no small sums. Careful consideration is highly advised, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: Welcome! Would you like to have a bite? Everything's freshly made.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Azalai's order...

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: Ahaha, sure! I told him my Dried Fish is famous far and wide and will definitely sell for a good price.

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: This amount of Mora will get you some Dried Fish. Just say the word and I'll make a fresh batch for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll start drying it now?

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: Of course not! What I meant was going to my warehouse to take the Dried Fish out and seasoning them to elevate their flavor profile.

dialogues.speaker: Jahangir
dialogues.text: Wait a minute... With the cost considered, you won't be able to buy that much Dried Fish after all.

choices.text: I'd like to place my order here.

response.speaker: Jahangir
response.text: Okay! I'll send one of my employees to deliver the order when I'm done making Dried Fish.

choices.text: I—I'm going to look elsewhere...

response.speaker: Jahangir
response.text: Huh? No need to rush, the price is negotiable. Besides, you won't find such tasty Dried Fish anywhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Azalai up to speed on sourcing goods...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: I see, the quality of Butrus' Dried Fish is always reliable, and the quantity... not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: When the goods arrive, I'll have to send some to doctor Maruf as thanks for treating my leg injury last time.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: There's also Raef and Fodil, they helped me unload cargo...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Ahem! Thanks for your help, Traveler. This is your remuneration. And this Mora, please take it along, too.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Fortunately, you ordered from Butrus. Giving some Dried Fish away shouldn't be a problem considering the order quantity.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Azalai up to speed on sourcing goods...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Ordered from Jut's? Are the prices high? Well, I'll have to raise my price point to match the cost then.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: But these spices seem to be of very high quality. I should not worry about selling them...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: By the way, Traveler, this is your remuneration.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Azalai up to speed on sourcing goods...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Purchased from Jahangir? The price is... *gasp* How can it be so pricey? What spices does he use? Mora itself?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: It's nothing I can't handle. Worst case scenario, I'll cut the Dried Fish up and sell it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Ah... Um, here is your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: How many pieces can these be cut into?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: How's it going, Traveler? Did you place the order for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.
